Here’s a quick roundup of some of the most highly regarded crime‑thriller films released in 2020 (in no particular order):

| Film | Director | Notable Cast | Why It Stands Out |
|------|----------|--------------|-------------------|
| **The Invisible Man** | Leigh Whannell | Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson-Cohen | A fresh take on the classic horror‑thriller hybrid, blending psychological suspense with sci‑fi twists. |
| **The Trial of the Chicago 7** | Aaron Sorkin | Eddie Redmayne, Sacha Baron Cohen | A courtroom drama that doubles as a tense political thriller, with razor‑sharp dialogue and strong performances. |
| **The Gentlemen** | Guy Ritchie | Matthew McConaughey, Charlie Hunnam | Ritchie's signature fast‑paced style, witty banter, and intricate heist plot keep viewers on edge. |
| **The Irishman** | Martin Scorsese | Robert De Niro, Al Pacino, Joe Pesci | Though more of a crime epic, its slow‑burn narrative and masterful storytelling deliver a gripping thriller experience. |
| **The Hunt** | Thomas Vinterberg | Mads Mikkelsen, Nikolaj Coster-Waldau | A tense, claustrophobic thriller that examines paranoia and social dynamics in a small community. |
| **The Nightingale** | Jennifer Kent | Lily James, David Wenham | A gritty, atmospheric thriller set in 19th‑century Australia, blending historical drama with suspense. |
